title: Dedicated PostgreSQL SignalR protocol messages
description: OperationChanged notifications are hints only; the authenticated HTTP operation snapshot is authoritative. A matching successful void SubscribeToOrder Completion permits the authenticated snapshot fetch. For a failed SubscribeToOrder Completion, RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE is terminal: stop watching, do not retry or fetch the snapshot, and show not-found behavior indistinguishably from an absent resource. SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is transient: leave unsubscribed, do not fetch the snapshot, and retry SubscribeToOrder with bounded exponential backoff and jitter capped at 30 seconds. Unknown error codes are non-retryable: stop watching and do not fetch. Completion error values are stable codes only; never expose exception text or secrets.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing per operation. Decimal string avoids IEEE-754 precision loss; compare as arbitrary-precision integers, never lexicographically.
